info.title: Recruitment backend — implemented client surface
info.description: Password signup/login/verification/reset, staff-owned vacancies, locked intake, mock-only processing and shared review/CSV. React UI consumes these contracts; no live AI/interviews.

servers.description: Local backend; frontend uses /api through its dev proxy

post.summary: Candidate-only password signup; verify email before login
post.description: Ignores client role. Duplicate signup never overwrites account. Sends verification code; no session. Password 12–128 characters.
Database role; ten requests/socket peer/path/60s. Sets HTTP-only cookie; do not store token.

post.summary: Verify email once; no automatic login
Save password with reset code; revoke sessions

get.summary: Admin/recruiter reads answers, task results, corrections and review status

patch.summary: Admin/recruiter updates optional review status or separate extraction corrections
patch.description: Completion never requires successful extraction and does not gate export or make selection decisions. No candidate answer/file mutation. Stale review revision returns 409.

get.summary: Admin/recruiter exports all applications, reviewed or not
get.description: Includes answers, original/effective extraction, failure/evidence/provenance/correction columns and review status. Blank unavailable values remain distinct from successful empty results via status. Protected document IDs, no public links. Snapshot-consistent; capped at 1000 rows/10 MiB. No query filters.

200.description: Private attachment CSV, quoted and formula-guarded

post.description: Multipart answers is a JSON string keyed by input id. File part names are document input ids. One file per input; 10 MiB/file, 25 MiB combined. Optional accept/limit add constraints. 201 creates; 200 returns existing unchanged, even after close. No processing execution. Candidate session and trusted Origin required.

additionalProperties.description: Part name equals a document input id

500.description: Storage/database failure; rows rolled back and object cleanup attempted

get.summary: Admin/recruiter read-only summaries for a vacancy
get.description: Unknown vacancy returns empty page. Dataset-wide filtering/sorting before pagination.

get.summary: Candidate lists own submissions; admin/recruiter list all
Read locked answers, frozen form and document metadata
get.description: Candidate can read own record only (foreign record 404). All admin/recruiter staff can read; staff alone receives processingDefinition. Interviewer denied. No mutation endpoint.
Same record access as application detail. Attachment only, octet-stream, nosniff, private/no-store and sandbox headers. Extension is not content verification or a malware safety guarantee.

get.summary: Admin/recruiter list of all vacancies and owner identities

post.summary: Admin/recruiter creates a draft owned by the current actor

get.summary: Admin/recruiter detail, including private task configuration

patch.summary: Owner edits draft only; replace both definitions together

post.summary: Owner validates/publishes draft and locks it
post.description: Requires at least one answer/document input. Already-published is idempotent for the owner, even with an old expectedRevision. Closed cannot reopen.

post.summary: Owner closes published vacancy without deleting it
post.description: Draft cannot close. Already-closed is idempotent. Closing blocks new submissions; existing applications remain readable.

get.summary: Published/open vacancy summaries only; no owner details
Safe job/form projection; no processing/owner metadata

post.description: Supports email-verification, forget-password and legacy sign-in. HTTP 200 acknowledges acceptance, not guaranteed delivery. Development file mode captures privately. Three requests/peer/path/60s.

post.summary: Verify code; create/reuse account and set session cookie
post.description: Role is server-controlled. Name/image are optional initial-account fields. Opaque token in response is sensitive; clients should use the HTTP-only cookie. Email-OTP plugin allows three sign-in requests per socket peer/path per 60 seconds.

Set-Cookie.description: HTTP-only session cookie; do not manually parse/store it in application code

post.description: Also succeeds without a session. Recommended body is empty JSON. No OAuth provider logout is configured.

get.summary: Library session lookup; anonymous result is 200 null
get.description: Used by Better Auth client SDK. Session material is sensitive. Prefer /me for the smaller application actor shape.
Temporary protected access-check endpoint, not a staff directory. Candidate receives 403.

503.description: At least one dependency unavailable; no credential/error details

WriteOrigin.name: Origin
WriteOrigin.description: Must equal configured WEB_ORIGIN or the origin of BETTER_AUTH_URL

VacancyStatus.name: status
VacancyStatus.description: Public list remains published-only even if another status is requested

ReviewFilter.name: review
ReviewFilter.description: Staff only; candidate request with review filter returns 403

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Default development cookie. Let browser/SDK manage it; HTTPS deployments may use a secure-prefixed name.

ReviewPatch.description: Supply status or nonempty corrections; task IDs must be configured/unique. null is an explicit manual null; remove:true removes override.

result.description: Original result; never changed by HR correction

effectiveValue.description: Latest saved correction if present, otherwise successful original result; null means unavailable

answers.description: Stable input IDs; not document/separator ids

NumberArgs.description: When supplied min must not exceed max; numbers must be finite

DocumentArgs.description: Omitted accept/limit means unrestricted business constraints, still capped at 10 MiB/file and 25 MiB/submission. Extension matching is not content validation.

FormDefinition.description: Input IDs and answer names must be unique; draft may be empty, publish needs an answer/document input

ProcessingDefinition.description: Configuration only, not live extraction. Task IDs/output keys unique; output keys cannot collide with answers; sourceInputId must reference a document.

otp.description: Six-digit emailed code; incorrect/used code returns INVALID_OTP

name.description: Initial name for a new account; does not update existing account

image.description: Optional initial profile image URL; not required by our UI

token.description: Sensitive opaque session token; do not log/store in frontend

ExtractionReview.description: Private optional HR review; original results preserved alongside corrections

Application.description: Locked application; private/no-store. Candidate projection excludes processingDefinition

IntakeBadRequest.description: Invalid UUID/query/body, malformed multipart/JSON or answers/files fail form constraints; validation may include issues with path/message

UploadTooLarge.description: File exceeds 10 MiB or combined files exceed 25 MiB

VacancyBadRequest.description: Invalid UUID/query/payload or unpublishable form; definition errors include issues with path/message

VacancyNotFound.description: Missing vacancy; public routes also hide draft/closed

VacancyConflict.description: Stale revision, locked record, or invalid transition

AuthBadRequest.description: Invalid input, unsupported OTP type, or invalid/expired/used code

AuthForbidden.description: Verification attempts exhausted or origin/security check failed

Forbidden.description: Account role is unavailable or not permitted

example.message: This action requires a different role.

RateLimited.description: Auth HTTP rate limit; not proof of invalid code. Current library uses X-Retry-After, not standard Retry-After. CORS does not currently expose this header to direct cross-origin browser callers.

example.message: Too many requests. Please try again later.

Unexpected.description: Unexpected server/library failure. Do not reinterpret as a bad code or successful operation; inspect HTTP status and show retry/unavailable state.
